name: WKO Veranstaltungen
notes: The /veranstaltungen landing page is JS-rendered and carries no listing; the real data is /veranstaltungen/kalender's list-card markup, fed by POST https://www.wko.at/api/event/filter (JSON body: count, offsetCurrent, aktuelle:true, place:'Österreich', ...). Response elements are pre-rendered HTML card fragments (same markup as kalender.html), no auth needed. Sorted roughly ascending by start date, so pagination stops once total is exhausted (whole dataset is only ~1865 nationwide upcoming events spanning to ~May 2027, well past the 180d horizon knob, so it's always fetched in full rather than horizon-limited - cheap, ~10 requests at count=200 each). Nationwide (Austria), not Vienna-only, matching the aurena precedent: district/city only populate for the ~11%/63% of events with an Austrian postal code in the card (foreign trade fairs and many in-person events show only a city name or nothing). category and price_min are never on the list card (only on each detail page's ld+json, not fetched to keep request volume sane) so both are always null.
